{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Consulate''' of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]] was located within the confines of the [[Adarlon spaceport]]. It housed inspectors from [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]], as well as a one hundred strong [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] unit.
